project_overview.purpose: Personal knowledge-base RAG assistant that answers questions from a single user's own notes (Markdown files) by retrieving relevant passages and generating a grounded answer with citations back to the source note
project_overview.target_users: A single individual user querying their own personal notes; not multi-tenant, no other users
project_overview.deployment_environment: Single-machine local script/CLI, no hosting required; only outbound calls are to the embedding API and OpenRouter

core_features: Ingestion Script (Python): reads a local folder of Markdown notes, chunks each file by heading, tags each chunk with its source filename
Embedding Step (Python): generates a vector embedding for each chunk using a hosted embedding API; re-embeds only files that changed since the last run
Local Vector Store (SQLite + vector extension, or a flat file index): stores chunk embeddings and metadata for similarity search

Query + Generation (Python, via OpenRouter): given a user question, retrieves the top-k most similar chunks, then sends them plus the question to OpenRouter, which routes to a configured model (e.g. Claude or GPT), generating an answer with inline citations to the source note filename
key_user_flows: User runs the ingestion script against their notes folder -> new/changed files are chunked and embedded -> Local Vector Store is updated
User asks a question via CLI -> top-k relevant chunks are retrieved -> OpenRouter generates a cited answer -> answer is printed with the source filenames it drew from
integration_points: OpenRouter API (model-agnostic access to Claude, GPT, and other hosted LLMs for generation)

non_functional_requirements.performance: Answer latency under 5 seconds end-to-end for a single query on a typical notes folder (under 500 files)
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Single user, single machine; no concurrent query load expected
non_functional_requirements.availability: No uptime target; personal tool, run on demand
non_functional_requirements.security: Notes may contain personal information; embeddings and chunks stored locally only, never uploaded except as query context sent to the embedding API and OpenRouter at query time
non_functional_requirements.observability: Simple log per query: question, retrieved chunk sources, latency; no dashboard required

existing_systems: Local folder of Markdown notes (existing, user-owned)
technical_constraints.budget_infra_limits: Pay-per-use pricing via embedding API and OpenRouter; no self-hosted inference

data_architecture.storage_requirements: Local vector index (SQLite or flat file) for chunk embeddings + metadata; no cloud storage
data_architecture.data_flow: Markdown notes -> Ingestion Script chunks by heading -> Embedding Step generates vectors -> Local Vector Store updates -> user query -> top-k retrieval -> OpenRouter generation -> cited answer printed to CLI
data_architecture.retention_compliance: All data stays local; no retention policy needed beyond the user's own notes folder

open_questions: Should the OpenRouter model choice be fixed at setup, or selectable per-query?
Is re-embedding on every changed file sufficient, or is a periodic full re-index needed to catch missed changes?
